title: GIG-4522: Fix Hydra Postmaclone Numerify And Unique Usernames
description: Parses faker formatter arguments on simple calls such as numerify('######') so generate() matches assertMethodExists instead of failing every row.

steps: After ngramx release, confirm produce no longer logs Unknown faker method numerify('######')
